svg.title: IKIGAI ATLAS application shell — desktop wireframe (1440 × 900)
svg.desc: Navy sidebar with the IKIGAI ATLAS symbol and wordmark, eight primary areas (My Atlas active, gold indicator) and Settings, Profile and Help at the bottom. Top bar with page title, global search, quick add, notifications and profile. My Atlas content on the ivory canvas: greeting and headline, next Waypoint hero, journey status, seven Life Dimension cards, Next Waypoints list and Recent Progress feed, using the single illustrative Master's degree Destination.
